author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
When taking photos of a map, please read the following;

- Use a normal FOV (Field of View), as Quake Pro and others can make it seem bigger than it is.
- Do not use heavy filtering. 1 or 2 filters to get the map across is fine, but don't do it for all of the images.
- Do not place huge text on your map image. This makes it harder to see the map and it is distracting.
- Do not use anything in Secret Settings unless it is x of these files;
   * color_convolve.json (Makes the map seem a little more vibrant)
   * fxaa.json (Just a little amount of blur from afar distance)
- Do not use fullbright so it takes away from how the map would look darkness-wise.
- Do not rotate the image in any way (such as mirroring, flipping upside down, and 4 squares).
- Do not take the screenshot in the same area/create duplicates.

You can do any of the above if you wish, but please keep it in a separate album from the map itself so we can see it in the general eyes of players. Thank you!

If you have any concerns, speak to your local mapdev ;P
